discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, very widely cited condensed-matter discovery. They build on the 2016 topological-phases prize, and their main figures already hold the Breakthrough, Dirac and Buckley prizes. A condensed-matter topic also fits the committee's habit of rotating fields after recent prizes in quantum circuits, machine learning and attosecond physics. Kane and Mele made the theoretical prediction (Z2 invariant, quantum spin Hall effect), and Molenkamp gave the first experimental confirmation in HgTe quantum wells. Shoucheng Zhang died in 2018 and so cannot be named.
